subject: Last-mile launch checklist: sales enablement, pricing, docs, support
messages:
From: Jade Park <jade.park@latticeai.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@latticeai.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Launch day final confirmation and entitlements

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the sync earlier this week. We’re down to the last internal checks before our legal/ procurement partners sign off. Two quick asks to close on before Monday: 

1) A single-slide summary for the CSM/AE team outlining any customer-facing limitations Day 1 (rate limits, allowed regions, known model tradeoffs).
2) Final pricing grid with line-item entitlements (token tiers, dedicated capacity upsell language) so procurement can confirm commitment terms.

Can you point me to the right owners and an ETA? We need something for our execs by EOD Monday.

Appreciate it — Jade
Product Lead, Platform Integrations
LatticeAI

From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jade Park <jade.park@latticeai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Launch day final confirmation and entitlements

Hi Jade —

Thanks — we’re on it. Quick owner breakdown and commitments: 

- Marissa (Enablement): single-slide CSM/AE summary and trainer notes — initial draft by Mon 09:00 PT.
- Karthik (Pricing): final pricing grid and entitlement language — delivered Mon 12:00 PT so procurement has time to review.
- Ben (Support/OPS): support-runbook + Day-1 escalation path and monitoring playbook — Mon 09:30 PT.

I’ll own the consolidated artifact and the QBR bullet that Laura will want for exec slides. I’m adding the drive folder and HubSpot deal link below; please drop any redlines there and I’ll pull into the final.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_launch_assets
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7845123

If procurement needs earlier sight, tell them to ping me directly — we can bump timelines.

—Tessa
Head of Go-to-Market Programs
Redwood Inference

Excellent progress and thank you for the fast turn. Two final asks before I include this in the QBR slide deck: 

1) Tessa — one-line risk for exec slide (30 words max) capturing the single biggest unresolved dependency (if any).
2) Marissa and Ben — two bullets each for the QBR slide: readiness status (green/yellow/red) and one mitigation per risk.

I’ll finalize the exec slide and circulate by Tue 09:00 PT. Jade — I’ll include the single-slide summary and the pricing grid as appendices for your exec review.
